name: Portfolio
summary: Paintings, design, animation and video by discipline, each with its picture, artist and page.
use_when: The site shows visual work such as paintings, graphic design, animation or video, grouped by discipline
Each piece needs its own address, credited to the artist who made it
Artists add and edit their own pieces, and staff edit all of them
avoid_when: Pieces are only for sale and need no showcase; use shop
It's an uncurated photo dump; a gallery block on a page is enough
The work is music or writing: that's discography or blog

permissions.description: Add pieces, and edit and delete the ones credited to you
Edit and delete every piece, and credit it to anyone who may add pieces

settings.description: Pieces on each page of the Art page, from 6 to 60
The line under the Art page's title
Where "Commission work like this" goes: a path on the site or an https address; empty hides it
